signal: Alianza raised a $61M Series E in early 2025 and completed its acquisition of Metaswitch from Microsoft, expanding its reach with service providers.

email.body1:
Rachel, saw Alianza close its Series E and fold Metaswitch in from Microsoft, broadening reach with service providers.

Expansion like that usually puts more strategic accounts in play than the West team can cover before momentum fades. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for your strategic accounts off hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Rachel, quick follow-up for Alianza.

After an acquisition, strategic pipeline targets tend to climb faster than headcount, and most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number. The gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your West team needs this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Rachel, last bit of proof for Alianza.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how your reply rate likely compares to other cloud communications companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Rachel, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling strategic pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Integrating an acquisition keeps the whole sales org heads-down for a while.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your strategic accounts motion? I'll tailor it to Alianza either way.
